title: New OTT Releases This Week
summary: Several new shows have been released on OTT platforms this week, including Gram Chikitsalay Season 2, Lingam, and Lock Upp Season 2. The releases coincide with the onset of monsoon season in India.
summary_points: New OTT releases include Gram Chikitsalay Season 2, Lingam, and Lock Up Season 2.
